name: Predator Open Source Load Testing
free_limit: Apache-2.0 self-hosted API load-testing platform with scheduled and distributed runs, reports, REST API and Docker/Kubernetes deployment; no software license fee or published software usage quota.
watch_out: Self-hosting requires compute, storage and potentially Kubernetes/database resources at your expense. Use tagged releases and matching Predator Runner versions; no free hosted load-generator infrastructure is included.
